recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖中 FLAER/CD24 雙陰性的顆粒球占 97%、FLAER/CD14 雙陰性的單核球占 94.5%，紅血球 CD59 出現完全缺失（type III 40.4%）族群，這是 GPI 錨定蛋白缺失的大型 PNH clone；骨髓則呈紅血球系增生，符合溶血。
features: Flow: granulocytes gated on SSC vs CD15 show 97.03% FLAER-negative/CD24-negative PNH cells
Flow: monocytes gated on SSC vs CD64 show 94.54% FLAER-negative/CD14-negative PNH cells
Flow: red cells show CD59 type I 57.66%, type II 1.93% and type III (complete deficiency) 40.42%
Bone marrow aspirate and biopsy: hypercellular with marked erythroid hyperplasia, including clusters of erythroid precursors with open chromatin and mitoses; megakaryocytes present
CD34 IHC highlights vessels only, with rare positive cells and no increase in blasts
Peripheral blood: polychromatophilic macrocytes, occasional spherocytes and small red cell clumps (arrows) on a low-power smear
describe_en: High-sensitivity flow cytometry demonstrates a large PNH clone: 97.03% of gated granulocytes lack FLAER and CD24, 94.54% of gated monocytes lack FLAER and CD14, and red cells show 40.42% type III (complete CD59 loss) and 1.93% type II (partial loss) populations. The lower red cell clone size relative to granulocytes is expected with ongoing hemolysis of complement-sensitive type III cells and/or transfusion. The bone marrow aspirate and core biopsy are hypercellular with marked erythroid hyperplasia and preserved megakaryocytes; CD34 immunostain highlights vessels without increased blasts. The peripheral blood smear shows polychromasia and red cell anisocytosis with small red cell clumps. Findings are consistent with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria with a large clone; morphology alone is nonspecific and the diagnosis rests on the flow cytometric GPI-anchor deficiency.

ddx.vs: AIHA shows spherocytes and DAT positivity but granulocytes and monocytes retain FLAER and GPI-linked antigens, and red cells lack a CD59 type III population.

ddx.dx: Aplastic anemia with a small PNH clone
ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows a hypocellular marrow with a small (often <10%) GPI-deficient population, whereas this marrow is hypercellular with erythroid hyperplasia and a clone >90% of granulocytes.
MDS may show erythroid hyperplasia but with dysplasia and cytogenetic abnormalities; GPI-deficient clones are small or absent.

ddx.dx: Congenital CD59 deficiency or CD55 (Inab) deficiency
ddx.vs: Isolated inherited deficiency affects a single antigen on all cells, whereas PNH shows loss of multiple GPI-linked proteins and FLAER binding in a clonal subset of cells.
